# Training week 2025-10

## Next steps

- Resting heart rate is down to 40 after three months.
- Grace joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day.
- Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises.
- Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour.
- Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week.

## Context

New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat. Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 3 kilometres. Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away. Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast. Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.

## Decisions

Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent. Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking. Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Intervals on Thursday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest. Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
